						<div class="post-wrapper">
							<div class="post-body"><div class="post-content un-no-sidebar-layout"><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row row-container" id="row-unique-2"><div class="row col-double-gutter double-top-padding double-bottom-padding double-h-padding limit-width row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-6 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell  vc_custom_1673342535889 no-block-padding" style="padding-top: 18px ;" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="vc_custom_heading_wrap "><div class="heading-text el-text" ><h2 class="h2" ><span>Kite camps Denmark</span></h2></div><div class="clear"></div></div><div class="uncode_text_column" ><p>You want to learn kitesurfing with other water sports fans, improve your skills on the board and have a great time together?<br />
Then our kite camp is perfect for you!<br />
Here different kite levels come together. We will start the day with a rich breakfast in our house. There we will discuss the wind conditions and pack the trailer. All those who want to learn kitesurfing will go to the fjord together with the freestyle fans. Here we will get you on the board or help you learn new tricks &#8211; depending on your level. With all wave lovers, or those who would like to become one, we will go kitesurfing together on the stormy North Sea directly behind our house. Here you can really let off steam! After a successful day we will all strengthen ourselves together with a delicious barbecue and let the evening end with a sundowner on the dune.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-6 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell  vc_custom_1673342545550 no-block-padding  unradius-xl" style="padding-top: 20px ;padding-right: 40px ;padding-bottom: 40px ;padding-left: 40px ;" ><div class="column-background background-element" style="opacity: 1;">
											<div class="background-wrapper">
												<div class="background-inner"></div>
												<div class="block-bg-overlay style-color-xsdn-bg" style="opacity: 0.1;"></div>
											</div>
										</div><div class="uncont" ><div class="vc_custom_heading_wrap "><div class="heading-text el-text" ><h2 class="h2" ><span>Details</span></h2></div><div class="clear"></div></div><div class="uncode_text_column" ><p>✓  6 days intensive group course, 4-5 hours training per day<br />
✓  4-6 participants per coach<br />
✓  Individual learning<br />
✓  Suitable for all levels: Beginners, water starters and advanced / VDWS Level 0-7<br />
✓  Professional support through VDWS-licensed instructors<br />
✓  Premium equipment from Core, Duotone and Cube Boards<br />
✓  Interesting theory chapters<br />
✓  Ventures and living with like-minded people<br />
✓  Surf activities during no wind</p>
<p>Price: starting at 990€ depending on room</p>
<p>Optional: Meal Package 350€ per person</p>
